reviews.author: Desiree Boseman
reviews.text: My car has been in and out of shops since August of 2025. i finally got to my breaking point and ventured out to find a new mechanic. Luckily I stopped by this shop, the owner seems to be the only person that could get my car up and running! I’m so relieved, after 10 months this mechanic had my car fixed and running in good condition within two weeks. Pricing was VERY reasonable, he even went out of his way to make me a new key (bc my old one was damaged) . I would highly recommend this shop for those of you who are looking to find a trusted, reliable mechanic!!!

reviews.author: Courtney Loftus
reviews.text: Ron was hands down an absolute gem! I called this morning, he said to come on in, offered me a ride home. A few hours later, he called & offered to come pick me up once my car was ready! Fair priced, super thorough. We will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Mya Brown
reviews.text: Hit something in the road & was stranded. Made it to this shop .5 miles down the road and they had me fixed up and ready to go in 30 min. Very kind people & super knowledgeable. Thank you again!

reviews.author: Jacqulyne Parrent
reviews.text: Very quick, reliable, highly professional and the most friendly service you can find. Could not have asked for a better person to fix my car up, and got it done far quicker than I could have predicted.

reviews.author: THOMAS HUNTER
reviews.text: Very friendly and knowledgeable. Was able to quickly diagnose my vehicle issues. Service scheduled soon. Will report service quality back.

reviews.author: Ryan Kay
reviews.text: Ronnie and his sons were excellent. They were the only place that would take my car on a Saturday at the last minute when I needed my alternator replaced. He got me squared away super quickly and was very friendly and professional. Can't recommend him enough.

reviews.author: Richard Hairopoulos
reviews.text: Nothing but good here. I went there by chance on a Saturday at 11:30am. I was just hoping to get someone to help out my daughter out with a repair. A pain in the but repair. They quoted a very reasonable price and said give us a couple of hours. I was hoping to get it fixed by maybe Wednesday. BUT no I get a call an hour and 45 minutes later saying it's done. Unbelievable friendly courteous & caring service not to mention excellent quality workmanship. These guys are unlike most places.

reviews.author: Misty Lilly
reviews.text: I am from out of state and needed to go back home, but I had to have repair work first. Ronnie and his sons were able to fit me in the next day, while others had week or more wait time, they got the job done well, saved me money $$ and had me back on the road. Highly recommend! I also needed an alignment after the work was done, and Ronnie hooked me up with finding one and even towed my vehicle to the facility to save the tires.

reviews.author: Jennifer Silvestro
reviews.text: I was so blessed that while at the restaurant across the street, Ronny came to my rescue when I discovered I had a flat tire. Not only was he going to put a spare on for me, but when he discovered it could be plugged, they took it across the street and fixed the tire. Unbelievable customer service! I HIGHLY recommend A and A Automotive

reviews.author: Angel Geerts
reviews.text: I called this morning (Saturday) and asked if I could get my ac charged. The gentleman told me to come in in 30 mins. I get there and they look at my truck and got my ac working. Very fast, professional, and kind. I felt very comfortable with them and the pricing was great. I highly recommend them to anyone. Thank you guys for getting my ac running again!

reviews.author: jaiymee hampton
reviews.text: This is a great place to get your car fixed the right way. The owner explains what is wrong with the car and goes over with you step by step what he’s going to do to fix it and the reason he’s doing it. Him and his son are very professional and sweet. I will recommend everyone in Anderson and surrounding areas to check them out.
